units.function: One mocked route test for returning active human company members to an operator who lacks manage-permissions authority.
units.dependencyDirection: Supertest/Express -> real access route/error middleware -> handwritten database query stub and mocked access/auth/Agent/activity services; no real schema, Identity provider or authorization service behavior.
units.keyDataModels: Board actor with company membership, active human membership principalId/status and auth-user id/name/email/image.
units.lifecycle: Authenticated operator requests company user directory -> membership rows and auth users are joined in route logic -> full contact projection is returned.
units.testAssessment: Sandboxed focused Vitest failed because Supertest could not listen; approved unsandboxed rerun passed 1/1. The single positive fixture establishes intent but cannot prove tenant/status filtering because its database stub ignores predicates. It omits all privacy, scale and negative authorization cases.
units.designRationale: Allow ordinary operators to discover human coworkers for assignment and collaboration without granting them membership-administration permission.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a first-class Organization/Principal directory that distinguishes identity, employment/membership, job, accountable-human responsibility, management relation and display profile while supporting enterprise OIDC/SCIM/LDAP adapters and privacy controls.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT behind IdentityPort and Organization/Principal application projections. Return purpose-specific fields with explicit directory.read capability, tenant/status enforcement, pagination/search and audit/privacy policy. Keep stable internal principal IDs and external identities separate; project accountable roles and responsibility eligibility without leaking provider records into core.
units.responsibilityConflict: The response identifies people but cannot answer who is responsible for which Agent/job/action. Operator membership alone reveals all emails, while no responsible-human role, employment validity, delegation, certification or data-purpose evidence is represented.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed focused Vitest: failed from Supertest listen EPERM
units.securityFindings: HIGH tenant-proof gap: the DB stub ignores where clauses, so the only test cannot catch missing company, principalType or active-status predicates. HIGH privacy gap: every operator receives all member emails and arbitrary external image URLs without field-level policy, purpose, audit or minimization assertions. MEDIUM availability gap: no pagination or limit is visible in the contract test. Missing cases include cross-company/unaffiliated users, inactive/suspended members, Agent/service principals, stale/missing users, multiple memberships, instance admins, field redaction, image URL safety and stable error responses.
